contract: ../DESIGN.md v1.5 review contract and ../RESEARCH.md source observations. Existing design tokens, no audio/demo, sampled data boundaries and reversible focus.

accessibility.evidence: Native ArrowRight advanced slider/model cursor from 70 to 71. Escape exited focus and restored the header control. Exit/source stay visible. Color-coded axes also use solid/dashed lines and different point shapes. Full screen-reader QA remains unperformed.

responsive.evidence: Five target sizes checked across all main/subscreens and six graph screens with extra-large values: no horizontal document/pane overflow. Arabic raw identifiers, scalar timestamps and an LTR time slider inspected. Hidden scrollbar tracks retained.

loading.evidence: Stable layout before schema; selectors populate with 88 primary fields and 88 plus a none option for comparison.

empty.evidence: No packets: waiting text, em dashes and disabled hold/cursor; actual no-data capture review-empty-v150.png.

error.evidence: Existing UDP occupied-port rollback/configuration errors remain covered by integration tests. Invalid/missing engine maximum clears its scale in a dedicated gauge test.

partial.evidence: One sample can be held but the slider remains disabled; missing secondary raw value displays em dash. No zero substitution or fabricated interpolation.

success.evidence: 23 tests pass. Held samples remain at 121 after live source grows to 122; selected sample timestamp matches the exact captured index. Gap boundary preserved. Fixtures are isolated browser memory and cleared by reload.

permission.reason: The new held-review and CSS focus controls request no browser permissions. Existing fullscreen/network behavior remains covered by the baseline; target-device firewall prompts remain untested.

renderedEvidence.observation: Arabic light paired-channel view; raw and rounded values, shared sampled cursor, explicit fixture label.
Landscape focus retains source and exit; plot and controls do not overlap.
Long raw channel identifier in Arabic tablet layout, independent scales and exact values.
Desktop paired signals with a visible gap and held-time cursor; explicit fixture label.
French wide-screen single-channel mode, translated no-comparison option and exact-value detail.
